headline: Executive order signed April 15, 2025, aimed at changing how the federal government buys goods and services.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with federal procurement, the rules and process the government uses to buy goods and services from private companies. The title suggests it aims to simplify or change those rules. No summary was provided, so the specific changes are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Businesses that sell to the federal government
who_it_affects.how: They may face changes to the rules they follow when bidding on or carrying out government contracts.
They may need to follow new or revised buying procedures.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 15, 2025; specific deadlines were not provided.
